events.hit: Quiet material/element variants; 200ms per owner; DOT 500ms shared bucket; significant is presentation metadata, not a new critical rule
events.windup: enemy-windup; boss → boss-warning; targets of ordinary windups have warning priority
events.release: enemy-release (basic attack resolution, or windup enters charge/recovery; cancellation stays silent)
events.material: hit-wood / hit-stone, coalesced with projectile cover impact
events.projectile_launch: Actual launch only: physical/element family, hostile variants, class-specific transformed variants
events.projectile_impact: Confirmed collision only: elemental impact or physical flesh/metal/wood/stone/barrier; suppress duplicate hit sample
events.enemy_defeat: defeat-soft coalesced 320ms; boss drives victory music
events.quest_report: quest-report shared notification; one outcome per cause
events.shrine_activate: shrine-activate positional world cue; combines attunement outcome
events.portal_charge: portal-charge UI accepted channel; not arrival
events.ascension: One-time class transformation, positional for teammates
events.ascended_release: Class-specific cue at actual signature resolution

atmosphere.landmarks: nearest supported magical/water/fire feature, never a loop per prop

unsupported: No crossbow or separate physical-bolt mechanic exists; no invented crossbow cues.
No supported critical-hit flag; significant means actual direct damage above a presentation threshold.

mix.masterMute: Stops effects, procedural beds, current/fading score; no queued combat replay

gaps: Variants distinguish class/category, not every ability with its own exclusive timbre.
No continuous burn/bleed/summon hum: actual damage is intentionally coalesced.
Flesh is the fallback for unarmored actors; explicit armor/structures/cover define other materials, not fabricated anatomy.
Entrance/floor/chamber/exit changes share a quiet transition cue; no voice announcements.
A small original synthesized score is integrated; no acoustic performances or realistic environmental recordings.
Human headphone/speaker listening and physical mobile audio-policy/performance review remain outstanding.
